notes: Key-visual cel look: tapered line art, one hard shadow tone per surface, jagged specular bands on layered hair locks, with a wine-haired woman with a stand-collar jacket, a slate-haired man in a shirt, tie and coat, and an android laptop whose glowing glass face carries HUD details. Think and sad on the two people use their own drawn eyes so the sideways and downcast looks read for certain, which trades the blink and pointer tracking in those two moods.
